t:
MIGA promotes Foreign Direct Investment (FDI) into developing countries by:-

I. Providing political risk insurance for foreign investments in developing countries
II. Providing dispute resolution services for guaranteed investments to prevent disruptions to developmentally beneficial projects
III. Promoting free trade in services
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Law of reinsurance is based primarily on the ______________________.
e: Correct answer: Law of contract (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to excess of loss treaty.

I. Both working and catastrophe covers arranged on a layered basis provide reinsurance protection to the retained business and enable cost reduction in using less of proportional arrangements.
II. The lower layer is rated on exposure.
III. The higher layers tend to be rated on the extent of cover provided.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ABC Insurance Co. has fixed its retention limit at Rs. 20,00,000 for fire insurance. The company has received a fire insurance proposal for Rs. 30,00,000. What will be the 'surplus reinsurance' requirement?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 10,00,000 (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement.

I. The larger the portfolio the smaller the degree of fluctuation.
II. The stability of a portfolio as it grows and in contrast to the relative volatility of a small portfolio is referred to as balance.
III. The aim in determining retention is not to eliminate fluctuation but to determine the degree of acceptable fluctuation.
e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Per Risk retention:-

I. Can be managed through controlled and informed decisions
II. By allowing a catastrophe reserve for funds to accumulate and be available over the long term
III. Relates to the number of individual risks that could be hit by one even
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the zones that are highly exposed to earthquake.

I. Iran
II. Iraq
III. Afghanistan
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which principle calls for the disclosure by the reinsured to the reinsurer of every material fact relating to the risk to be insured?
e: Correct answer: Doctrine of good faith (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
As per Arbitration clause, who among the following are required to interpret an agreement as an honourable engagement and to make their award with a view to effecting the general purpose of the agreement in a reasonable manner rather than in accordance with a literal interpretation of the language?

I. A single arbitrator
II. Two arbitrators, one to be appointed in writing by each party
III. An Umpire to be appointed in writing by a mutually agreed authority
e: Correct answer: I, II or III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
____________ is defined as 'a reinsurance contract under which the ceding insurer has the option to cede and the reinsurer has the option to accept a specific risk of a specific insured.

I. Facultative reinsurance
II. Treaty reinsurance
III. Portfolio reinsurance
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _______________ clause states that reinsurances are fully subject to the same terms and conditions as the original insurance.
o: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proporti
Net retained lines: Protecting net retention
e: Correct answer: Original conditions :Follow the fortunes (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Given below are some of the advantages of protection offered by reinsurance. Identify the incorrect option.
o: An insurer has less capacity to accept though he needs to restrict exposure to a level commensurate with his own net resources
The net premiums and losses are stabilised over a
The incidence of loss is widely distributed
The problem of accumulations within each line of b
An insurer can accept new and untested risk exposu
e: Correct answer: An insurer has less capacity to accept though he needs to restrict exposure to a level commensurate with his own net resources (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following investment/s increases the exposure to capital loss?

I. Long term investments
II. Stock market investments
III. Investments in liquid assets
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: __________ refers to the professional management of investments such as stocks and bonds along with real estate, set realistic goals to grow the insurer's / reinsurer's wealth and measure the performance.
e: Correct answer: Asset management (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following statement best describes "retention per risk"?
o: All losses occurring within the contract period ar
Under this method, claims under policies issued or
The retention under the excess of loss will be fixed at an amount less than the amount which they accept for their net account on any one risk under proportional reinsurance arrangement
It is the basis for rating working excess of loss
This assists the reinsurer to judge rating consist
e: Correct answer: The retention under the excess of loss will be fixed at an amount less than the amount which they accept for their net account on any one risk under proportional reinsurance arrangement (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
A typical checklist of considerations for a single Mega Risk Facultative Reinsurance Program includes:-

I. Reinsurers with superior credit rating
II. Determination of Deductible Time Excess / Other terms
III. Rate net of commission
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to Business Covered: Attachment of cessions proportional clause.

I. Deals with the attachment of individual cession and is used in respect of automatic forms of reinsurance such as a treaty
II. Intends that reinsurance will apply simultaneously and automatically with that of the ceding insurer as soon as his retention is exceeded with reference to surplus reinsurance
III. For quota share reinsurance the cession would be simultaneous and automatic with the liability of the ceding insurer under his original acceptance
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following regulation ensures that every risk written by insurer must be met with adequate assets?
e: Correct answer: Solvency margin regulation (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In which of the following cases, reinsurers are more likely to examine the adequacy of business rate levels?

I. Reinsurers on first surplus
II. Reinsurers of high surplus
III. Facultative reinsurance
e: Correct answer: II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In case of proportional treaty reinsurance, where treaties are on a 'worldwide' basis, the ___________ exposures are usually excluded because of the different legal systems and insurance practices prevailing in those countries.
e: Correct answer: Canada (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
The premiums for which of the following business/es usually shown at original gross rates and the reinsurance commission rate is then applied?

I. Fire proportional reinsurance
II. Accident proportional reinsurance
III. Marine proportional reinsurance
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: An organization can internally connect all its executives and offices through a private internet arrangement which is called  ______________.
e: Correct answer: Internet (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In ________________, the reinsured bears all loss amounts up to the deductible and the reinsurer pays the balance of any loss that exceeds the deductible, up to an agreed limit.
e: Correct answer: Excess of loss reinsurance (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In non-proportional reinsurance XL is the abbreviated form for ____________________.
e: Correct answer: Excess of loss (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the zones in southern Europe that are highly exposed to earthquake.

I. Yugoslavia
II. Rumania
III. Morocco
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In case of a proportional treaty, the facility of portfolio entry premium and portfolio withdrawal premium do not apply to ________ reinsurance business.
e: Correct answer: Marine (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In proportional reinsurance, the reinsurer shares ______of the insurer in the same proportion as per agreement in the treaty.

I. Sum insured
II. Premiums
III. Claims
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: All of the following statement with regard to finite risk programme are TRUE EXCEPT:-
o: Aggregate nature of coverage incorporating all pre
Cover is designed to operate on multi-year basis
If cover runs loss free during its multi-year term, premiums as paid   are non-refundable to policyholder
Finite Risk programmes are usually written by a si
e: Correct answer: If cover runs loss free during its multi-year term, premiums as paid   are non-refundable to policyholder (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In such a case if a insolvent insurer's liability to pay a claim has been established the reinsurer is:-

I. Liable to pay his share of liability as determined
II. Liable to pay whole amount as insurer has become insolvent
III. Not liable to pay as reinsurer does not has liability to pay to insured
e: Correct answer: Only I (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ABC Insurance Co. has a proportional treaty with reinsurer X Re Co. The insurer has a retention limit of Rs. 5,00,000 and cedes the remaining risk. The insurer has accepted a risk of Rs. 10,00,000 and received a premium of Rs. 2,000. How much premium will be paid by the insurance company to the reinsurer?
e: Correct answer: Rs. 1,000 (from the IC85 question bank).

t: What is the principal object of the Oil & Energy Insurance Syndicate, Kingdom of Bahrain?
o: To assist the respective governments in setting up
To underwrite oil and energy business from FAIR members
To accept reinsurance and retrocession business fr
To provide political risk insurance (guarantees) t
To operate as regional pool supporting the countri
e: Correct answer: To underwrite oil and energy business from FAIR members (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Internationally specialist pools operate to assist in:-

I. Terrorism
II. War
III. Nuclear risks
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which clause provide that if a loss occurs between the time of the acceptance of a risk and the entry of the cession in the reinsurance register, the ceding insurer would retain not less than the amount usually retained according to his rules and practice for risks of that particular class?
o: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proportional
Net retained lines: Protecting net retention
e: Correct answer: Business Covered: Attachment of cessions  proportional (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the true statement with regard to Arbitration clause.

I. This clause is found in all reinsurance agreements and shows the intentions of the parties to resolve disputes as to the interpretation of the agreement.
II. A dispute would be referred to a single Arbitrator or to two Arbitrators, one to be appointed in writing by each party.
III. In the case of disagreement between the two Arbitrators, an Umpire needs to be appointed in writing by a mutually agreed authority.
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
The principal object of the F.A.I. R. Pool is to accept reinsurance and retrocession business from:-

I. Asian market
II. African market
III. European market
e: Correct answer: I and II (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following items are deducted from claims costs?

I. Recoveries from proportional reinsurers
II. Salvage
III. Subrogation
e: Correct answer: I,II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Which of the following alternative carrier method/s is/are global phenomenon dating back to 1950s?

I. Self insurance
II. Risk Retention Groups
III. Pool
IV. Captive
e: Correct answer: Only IV (from the IC85 question bank).

Australia is considered to be a high risk zone that is exposed to:-

I. Bush fire
II. Tornadoes
III. Storms
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: _________ retention is managed through reasonable estimation of financial consequences and by allowing a catastrophe reserve for funds to accumulate and be available over the long term.
e: Correct answer: Per Event (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
A typical checklist of considerations for a single Mega Risk Facultative Reinsurance Program includes:-

I. Route survey for movement of critical machineries
II. Project monitoring for delays
III. Claims control clause-establishing communication system & procdures for preliminary loss intimation / survey / technical support
e: Correct answer: I, II and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ______________ is a corporation owned and operated by insurance companies, that band together as self-insurers and forms an organization that is chartered and licensed as an insurer in at least one state of US to handle liability insurance.
e: Correct answer: Risk retention groups (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In 1961, the Government of India made it compulsory by statute on the part of every insurer to cede ________ in Fire and Marine Cargo.
e: Correct answer: 20% (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Which of the following statement is correct with regard to Sliding scale of Commission?
o: It is an item paid by the reinsurer to the ceding
This is very easy to account as the commission pay
This is a method of arriving at a rate of commission based on the loss ratio of the treaty during any one treaty year or during any one underwriting year
When a reinsurer receives business as an inward re
Where a reinsurer receives a share of a treaty via
e: Correct answer: This is a method of arriving at a rate of commission based on the loss ratio of the treaty during any one treaty year or during any one underwriting year (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Identify the features of Operative clause.

I. It brings out clearly the obligatory nature of reinsuring
II. It details the guarantees offered with the contract
III. The method of cession is stated
e: Correct answer: I and III (from the IC85 question bank).

t: In which clause, the method of cession is stated?
e: Correct answer: Operative clause (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
In motor reinsurance, which is the most common method of reinsurance?

I. Facultative reinsurance
II. Excess of loss cover
III. Surplus treaty
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: A reinsurance operates to make good to a reinsured a share of an amount which he has paid or become liable to pay. This is known as ___________________.
e: Correct answer: Principle of indemnity (from the IC85 question bank).

t:
Given below are some statements related to treaty reinsurance. Identify the incorrect option.

I. This is a method of reinsuring portfolio risks
II. Ceding insurer has the option of not sharing the risk following within the purview of the treaty
III. Reinsurer does not have the option of declining the risk falling within the purview of the treaty
e: Correct answer: Only II (from the IC85 question bank).

t: Service providers provide database access to their customers as an extension of the intranet to download and use certificates of insurance or to ascertain their own account balance status, etc. This access is called ______________.
e: Correct answer: Extranet (from the IC85 question bank).

t: ______________ is a rare form and was in use previously.
e: Correct answer: Facultative obligatory treaty (from the IC85 question bank).
